title: Alignment and implicit grids
learningObjectives: Explain alignment and implicit grids and use CSS Grid to create responsive two-dimensional layouts.

understand.concept: Grid alignment properties include justify-items, align-items, justify-content, align-content, justify-self, and align-self. The grid may also create implicit rows or columns when items are placed outside the explicitly defined tracks; grid-auto-rows and grid-auto-columns control their sizing.
understand.whyItMatters: Alignment properties operate at different levels: item alignment inside its grid area versus alignment of the grid tracks within the container. Implicit tracks appear automatically and should be sized intentionally.
understand.analogy: Items can be aligned inside their own rooms, while the whole set of rooms can be positioned inside the building.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; CSS Grid follows formal track sizing, placement, and alignment algorithms.

explain.narrative: The grid creates two explicit columns and implicit rows. Items are centered inside their grid areas.

examples.explanation: The grid creates two explicit columns and implicit rows. Items are centered inside their grid areas.
examples.expectedOutput: A rendered CSS Grid example demonstrating the topic.

practise.guidedTask: Add an item that creates another implicit row. Compare align-items with align-content and justify-items.
practise.independentTask: Build a responsive card or dashboard layout using this concept. Test long labels and narrow viewports.
hints: Inspect grid tracks with browser developer tools.
Check implicit tracks and minimum sizing.
Keep DOM and keyboard reading order logical.

questions.prompt: Which property sets the default alignment of grid items inside their grid areas along the block axis?
questions.explanation: align-items controls the default block-axis alignment of grid items.

questions.prompt: What should a responsive Grid layout preserve?
options: Readable content and logical DOM order
A fixed number of columns at every width
Visual placement regardless of keyboard order
questions.answer: Readable content and logical DOM order
questions.explanation: Responsive layout should adapt while preserving access and meaningful reading order.
